row.evidence: Automox's pricing page offers 'Free SSO', and its Okta guide says Automox 'creates licenses for them as they attempt first login' (SAML auto-provisioning); no SCIM endpoint appears anywhere in its documentation corpus or API reference.
row.notes: New row. No SCIM (absence, medium): Automox's full docs corpus (llms-full.txt, 225 topics), the docs sitemap and the Console API OpenAPI spec contain no SCIM; provisioning is SAML JIT only, IdP-initiated, creating users as Read Only. Okta's OIN Automox app is SAML only. Pricing is per endpoint, not per user: Patch OS $1/endpoint/month with annual commitment (monthly billing also offered); Automate Essentials and Automate Enterprise are Custom Pricing. SSO is free on all tiers. API Access is marked only for Automate Essentials and Enterprise, so the user API is above the cheapest tier.

plans.name: Patch OS
plans.notes: Per-endpoint pricing. Comparison table: Single Sign-On checked, API Access not checked.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in Automox's docs: the full documentation corpus (225 topics, llms-full.txt) and the Console API spec contain no SCIM. User provisioning is SAML just-in-time only (IdP-initiated login).

auth.notes: OpenAPI securityScheme is HTTP bearer; keys are managed under Settings > Keys.

capabilities.notes: Delete = remove the user from the account (revokes access to all organizations). Roles are RBAC roles listed per account; zone (organization) access is granted through invitations and account-user calls.

webhooks_user_events.notes: The Webhooks API spec lists device, policy and worklet events only; no user events were found.

rate_limits.text: 100 authenticated requests/second and 15 unauthenticated requests/second for most APIs, counted per account.

user_api.notes: The pricing comparison table marks API Access for Automate Essentials and Automate Enterprise but not Patch OS (the $1/endpoint tier), so the API sits above the cheapest paid plan.

okta.notes: OIN app shows only SAML checked (no SCIM or provisioning capabilities); last updated Mar 2019.

entra.notes: Automox documents a custom Entra SAML app with SAML JIT provisioning; Microsoft Learn automox-tutorial returned 404.
